currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — FINAL.20 HF2D maker/size/code ordering verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.20 HF2D is merged and production verified. Product ordering is now maker group first, then smaller detected container size, then younger/natural product number. Maker-group order remains based on each maker's youngest product number. The same order is enforced across Product Master, Analysis > Inventory vehicle stock, and vehicle stocktake. Product Master copy now shows メーカー→容器サイズ→商品番号順. PR #130 merged to main at d3fc44abe6cc552e380dba9998e3e91b6c85d148. PR browser regression run 35434708459 and main-push run 35434818294 passed all seven gates; GitHub Pages deployment run 35434817808 and Vercel production status also passed. App/engine/DB/schema remain FINAL.20 / AN14B3B5 / 4 / 4.
scope: Use VENDRIVE normally; no active feature phase is open.
Group product lists by maker first; maker-group order uses each maker's youngest natural product number.
Within a maker, sort known container sizes from smaller to larger before considering product number.
When two products have the same detected size, sort by younger/natural product number.
Products whose size cannot be detected follow known-size products within the same maker.
Apply the same order to Product Master, Analysis > Inventory vehicle stock, and vehicle stocktake.
Only confirmed OCR reports may add/update product-master discovery data; draft OCR candidates remain excluded.
Classification inference remains proposal-only until explicit human confirmation.
Use GitHub Actions + Playwright/Chromium as the standard deterministic browser regression path.
Keep inventory movement semantics, OCR/report confirmation boundaries, learned numeric forecasting, Analytics engine, DB and schema unchanged.
nextActions: Use the real app and confirm the visible product order matches maker → smaller container size → younger product number.
Continue normal field evidence accumulation and classification confirmation where useful.
Reopen engineering only for new field friction or when the numeric promotion gate has enough evidence.
